_about: Public-domain C. E. Luthardt (1823-1902, Lutheran, professor at Leipzig) in pre-1930 English translations from T. & T. Clark, raw Internet Archive OCR: Apologetic Lectures on the Fundamental (1865), Saving (1868) and Moral (1873) Truths of Christianity (tr. Sophia Taylor), St. John the Author of the Fourth Gospel (tr. C. R. Gregory, 1875), St. John's Gospel Described and Explained (3 vols, tr. Gregory, 1876-78) and History of Christian Ethics vol. 1 (tr. W. Hastie, 1889). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
